Entry.JapaneseText: ワンダーシェフ
Entry.EnglishText: Wonder Chef

Entry.JapaneseText: 常夏の村の魔術師
Entry.EnglishText: Tropical Village Wizard

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑がりの男性
Entry.EnglishText: Heat-Sensitive Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 元宿屋前に立つ男性
Entry.EnglishText: Man by the Old Inn

Entry.JapaneseText: 我慢する男性
Entry.EnglishText: Enduring Man

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスク通の男性
Entry.EnglishText: Basilisk Expert

Entry.JapaneseText: 短気な男性
Entry.EnglishText: Short-Fused Man

Entry.JapaneseText: ハンバーグ好きの男性
Entry.EnglishText: Hamburg Steak Lover

Entry.JapaneseText: 痩せたい男性
Entry.EnglishText: Slimming(?) Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 少し悲観的な女性
Entry.EnglishText: Slightly Gloomy Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑さに立つ女性
Entry.EnglishText: Woman Standing in Heat

Entry.JapaneseText: 組織にいた男性
Entry.EnglishText: Former Organization Member

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスク狩りの男性
Entry.EnglishText: Basilisk-Hunting Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑さに慣れた男性
Entry.EnglishText: Man Used to Heat

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠を誇る男性
Entry.EnglishText: Proud Desert Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪を見たい少年
Entry.EnglishText: Snow-Admiring Boy

Entry.JapaneseText: 村を出たい女性
Entry.EnglishText: Village-Leaving(?) Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 挫折した女性
Entry.EnglishText: Set-Back Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: ４万ガルド払いますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Pay 40,000 Gald?

Entry.JapaneseText: 武器屋 ガーリック
Entry.EnglishText: Weapon Shop - Garlic

Entry.JapaneseText: 食材屋 サーロイン
Entry.EnglishText: Grocery Store - Sirloin

Entry.JapaneseText: 道具屋 スパイシー
Entry.EnglishText: Item Shop - Spicy

Entry.JapaneseText: オリーブヴィレッジ
Entry.EnglishText: Olive Village

Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: まだ魔術書はあるぞ。
Entry.EnglishText: I still have that tome of magic.

Entry.JapaneseText: ４万ガルドで頼むよ
Entry.EnglishText: You can have it for 40,000 Gald.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔界の眷属と契約するには 巨大生物の牙や海の宝石、 再結晶化の石が必要で、
Entry.EnglishText: For a pact with Daemonium's servants, you'll need... A great creature's tusk, a jewel of the sea, a recrystallized stone...

Entry.JapaneseText: 黒い木材や凍らない水を使えば、 異界の者との契約すら可能だという
Entry.EnglishText: And for a pact with another dimension's retainers, you'll want black wood and unfreezing water.

Entry.JapaneseText: まるで実感がわかない スケールの話だと思わないか？
Entry.EnglishText: But those claims are a bit too extraordinary to believe, aren't they?

Entry.JapaneseText: あつ～い……どうして こんなに暑いかって？ 砂漠だからだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: It's so hooot... "Why's it so hot?" I mean, we're in a desert, aren't we?

Entry.JapaneseText: 数万年前までは ここも緑に覆われてた っていうけどね……
Entry.EnglishText: Though, up until a few millennia ago, this place was full of verdant green...or so they say...

Entry.JapaneseText: あつ～い……毛穴が開いて 汗がばんばんばんと 流れる～
Entry.EnglishText: It's so hooot... I'm sweating so much... It's like my pores are floodgates, and someone left them wide open...

Entry.JapaneseText: これでも50年前より 涼しくなったって ……嘘つけ！
Entry.EnglishText: Someone told me it's cooler now than it was 50 years ago... What a dirty lie!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なんか、 木が枯れてるんだけど 暑さのせい？
Entry.EnglishText: ...The trees seem pretty wilted. Is that 'cause of the heat?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ってもう何年も 暑いんだけど、今更？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Wait, it's been hot like this for ages. Why now?

Entry.JapaneseText: もしかして、 前よりも暑くなってる？ だから木が枯れた？
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe it's even hotter than it used to be? And that's making the trees wilt?

Entry.JapaneseText: いやいや…… あ、でも昨日より 今日は少し暑いかも……
Entry.EnglishText: That can't be it... Though... I think it is a little hotter today than it was yesterday...

Entry.JapaneseText: 一時間立ってるだけで、 オケ一升分の汗が取れるんだ。 なんか商売にならないかな
Entry.EnglishText: If I stand here for an hour, I sweat enough to fill a whole bucket... I wonder if I could sell that somehow.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「オリーブヴィレッジの 新鮮な汗」！ 売れないかな～
Entry.EnglishText: "Fresh Olive Village Sweat"! Maybe someone'll buy it~?

Entry.JapaneseText: 売れないよね～
Entry.EnglishText: Nah, no one'll buy that~

Entry.JapaneseText: あつ～い……
Entry.EnglishText: It's so hooot...

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑いなら、家の中に入れよ って思うだろ？ 入れないんだな
Entry.EnglishText: You're probably thinking, "If it's so hot outside, why don't you go home?" I can't go home, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……大人の事情でね
Entry.EnglishText: ...For, ah, adult reasons.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは その昔、時空戦士が 泊まった宿屋「跡」だよ～
Entry.EnglishText: This is "what remains of" the inn where the Heroes of Time once stayed~

Entry.JapaneseText: 彼らを陰で支え、ダオス戦役で 散ったエドワード・モリスンも ここに泊まったんだ～
Entry.EnglishText: And Edward Morrison, who assisted them and perished nobly in Dhaos's War, also stayed here at one time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空戦士<Cless>が使ったカップや <Mint>が食べたグミの 食べ残しもあるんだって
Entry.EnglishText: The cup used by the Hero of Time <Cless> and a few pieces of a gel eaten by <Mint> also remain inside.

Entry.JapaneseText: よく残してたよね、 そんなの
Entry.EnglishText: It's great that they've been preserved, don't you think?

Entry.JapaneseText: あれ～、なんか椰子の木の 葉っぱの色が変だなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: What's this~? The color of those palm leaves has gone all funny, hasn't it...?

Entry.JapaneseText: おまけに元気がない…… なんだ？
Entry.EnglishText: And they really don't look like they're doing too well, either... What's that about?

Entry.JapaneseText: 植物が元気がない時には 水をやるのが一番だね
Entry.EnglishText: When your plants aren't doing well, the best thing to do is water 'em.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは昔、宿だったけど 儲からなくて廃業したんだ
Entry.EnglishText: This was an inn, long ago, but it wasn't very profitable, so it went out of business.

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空戦士も泊まった 由緒ある宿屋だったんだけどね～
Entry.EnglishText: The Heroes of Time themselves stayed here, you know~ It had some real history, this inn.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Klarth>が飲んだ フレアボトルの飲みかけ
Entry.EnglishText: There's a few drops of a flare bottle <Klarth> drank still left inside.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Arche>の寝たベッドのシーツも とってあるんだそうだよ
Entry.EnglishText: And the bed sheets <Arche> slept with were set aside, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: ちょっとコワいね、 この宿の主人
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe that old innkeeper was a bit of a creep, eh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑い…… 汗が止まらない…… 喉が渇いた……
Entry.EnglishText: It's hot... I can't stop sweating... My throat's dry...

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだ、 この汗を飲めば……
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, maybe if I drink my sweat...

Entry.JapaneseText: ダメだ、 それ昨日も考えた……
Entry.EnglishText: Nah... I tried that yesterday...

Entry.JapaneseText: 喉が渇いた…… でも、あの水を飲んだら 負けな気がする……
Entry.EnglishText: My throat's so dry... But, if I give in and drink that water, I'll feel like I've lost...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、でも…… 我慢、する……
Entry.EnglishText: No, but... No... I can still...endure...

Entry.JapaneseText: 宿屋の前のアイツ…… どうして……平気……なんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: Why's that guy...in front of the old inn...look like he's...doing fine...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑い……もう死ぬ…… 今死ぬ…… いや死なない……
Entry.EnglishText: It's so hot... I'm gonna die... Gonna die right now... No, I won't die...

Entry.JapaneseText: やばい……やばすぎる…… この暑さ……禁魔術級……
Entry.EnglishText: This is bad... This is really bad... This heat... It's like some forbidden dark magic...

Entry.JapaneseText: 目の前に、水があるのに…… 飲めない……つらさ…… 君たちは知らないだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: Seeing water...right in front of you... But you can't drink it... Such pain... You've never felt it, have ya?

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑すぎる…… もう限界だ……
Entry.EnglishText: It's way too hot... I'm at my limit...

Entry.JapaneseText: たおれそうだ…… 昨日もそう思った…… もう少し……がんばれる……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna pass out... But I thought that yesterday, too... I can hold on...a little longer...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……記録を作るんだ…… オリーブヴィレッジで…… １年間、屋外に……立った男……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm gonna make a new record... I'll be the first man...in Olive Village history... to stand outside...for a whole year...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……その前に…… ……別のニュースに…… なり、そう……
Entry.EnglishText: ...But before then... ...I might make headlines... for a different reason...

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスクってのが 砂漠にいるんだけど ここんとことんと見なくなった
Entry.EnglishText: There are basilisks in this desert, but we haven't seen much of them these days.

Entry.JapaneseText: 強さを求める連中が こぞってバジリスクを 狩ったせいだよ
Entry.EnglishText: A whole lot of people who were hoping to gain, or prove, strength decided to hunt them, you see.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今じゃ絶滅危惧種で保護対象って 言うけどさ……
Entry.EnglishText: They're protected as an endangered species, now...

Entry.JapaneseText: 保護しなくてもいいんじゃね？ いや、だって石化光線だぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: But do we really need to protect them? I mean, come on, they've got petrification rays and all, haven't they?

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスクの肉って 意外とやわらかくて 脂のってて美味いんだって
Entry.EnglishText: Basilisk meat is surprisingly supple. They say it has good marbling, too, and tastes great.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、みんな気味悪がって 食わなかったそうだ
Entry.EnglishText: But generally, no one would eat it, 'cause it gave 'em the creeps.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今でもバジリスク料理っての あるみたいだけど 高級料理なのさ
Entry.EnglishText: Some people actually cook with basilisk meat even now, and it's considered a delicacy, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一度、食ってはみたいが……
Entry.EnglishText: I'd like to try it at least once, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスクって言やぁ その強力な表皮だな
Entry.EnglishText: But basilisks are pretty famous for their tough hide, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 主に装備品の原料に 使われてたみたいだ
Entry.EnglishText: It was often used to make combat equipment.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、この村の店にある防具にも 使われてるんじゃないか？
Entry.EnglishText: Y'know, they probably use it to make the armor they sell at the shops here, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: くそー、魔女め やりやがった！
Entry.EnglishText: Goddammit, that witch has really done it this time!

Entry.JapaneseText: 干しといた干し椰子の実に 水かけやがって！ ダイナシだ！！
Entry.EnglishText: She poured water all over the palm fruit I'd left out to dry! It's totally ruined!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女め！ とっ捕まえて 屋根の上で 干し魔女にしてやる！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you damned witch! I'm gonna catch you, dry you up on my roof, and make witch jerky outta you!

Entry.JapaneseText: カラカラの骨と皮にして 三度の飯と一緒に 美味しくいただいてやる！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll have a little of your dried bones and skin with every meal! And I'll enjoy it, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女のヤツめ！ 許さん！ 今度はホッケ焼いてたら まんまと持っていきやがった！
Entry.EnglishText: That accursed witch! She won't get away with this! I grilled a mackerel and she made right off with it!

Entry.JapaneseText: にゃーんとか鳴きやがって なんのマネだ！
Entry.EnglishText: She let out some weird "nyaaan" cry, too! What the hell's she playing at!?

Entry.JapaneseText: オレの大事な夕食を！ オレの大切なホッケちゃんを！
Entry.EnglishText: My precious dinner! My cherished mackerel!

Entry.JapaneseText: 返せ！ バカやろー！ あ、魔女だからヤローじゃないか
Entry.EnglishText: Give it back! You son of a...! Wait, she's a witch, so I guess "son" isn't the right word...

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女のヤツが悪事を 働いてるってのはオレの とんだ誤解だったみたいだ……
Entry.EnglishText: Apparently, that witch wasn't playing all the nasty tricks I thought she was. That was all a big mistake on my part.

Entry.JapaneseText: くそーっ！ 誰だよ！ オレを騙したのは！ ゆるさーん！
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit...! Then who the hell was it!? Who tricked me!? You won't get away with thiiiis!

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰かがオレに 魔女が悪事を働いてるって ウソを吐きやがった！
Entry.EnglishText: Someone lied to me! Told me all these nasty tricks were the witch's work!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは人にバカにされるのが 一番嫌いなんだ！！
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing I hate more than being made a fool of!

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑い～…今日の夕飯は チーズINハンバーグかな
Entry.EnglishText: It's so hot... Maybe I'll have cheeseburg steak for dinner.

Entry.JapaneseText: チーズがとろけてて おいしいんだよねー！！
Entry.EnglishText: That melty cheese really is the best!

Entry.JapaneseText: 流れる流れる…… 体の中の悪いものが 全部汗になって……
Entry.EnglishText: It keeps flowing and flowing... The toxins and badness in my body, all turning to sweat...

Entry.JapaneseText: 汗だくダイエット敢行中……
Entry.EnglishText: I've committed to a sweat- based weight loss program...

Entry.JapaneseText: 脂肪が全部、汗になって 体の外に排出される……
Entry.EnglishText: All of my fat will turn to sweat, and leave my body through my pores...

Entry.JapaneseText: うーん…… 痩せるわ、これ……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmmm... I should have lost a little by now...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ……暑い…… 水分が足りなくなってきた……
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh... It's hot... My body water percentage has dropped too low...

Entry.JapaneseText: ビール飲みたい…… でも飲んだら脂肪になる、 ダイエットがムダになる……
Entry.EnglishText: I want to drink some beer... But if I do that, I'll put on weight and ruin my diet...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、喉渇いた…… このまま、どれくらい 何も飲まないで平気かな……
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh, my throat's so dry... Will I really be okay if I go on not drinking like this...?

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、もうすぐ 死ぬかも……
Entry.EnglishText: No, I'll probably die if I don't drink something soon...

Entry.JapaneseText: 汗だくダイエット敢行中…… ……ああ、ヤバイ、 幻が見えてきた……
Entry.EnglishText: I've committed to a sweat-based weight loss program, but... Ah, this is bad, I'm starting to see things now...

Entry.JapaneseText: あ……お母さん？
Entry.EnglishText: Ah... Mom...?

Entry.JapaneseText: いかんいかん こんなところで 死ぬわけには……
Entry.EnglishText: No, I can't go and die here...

Entry.JapaneseText: 痩せるぞぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm too busy losing weight...

Entry.JapaneseText: 冷たそうな水…… 飛び込んだらきっと 気持ちいいんだろうなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: That water looks so cool... I'm sure it'd feel great to jump into it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 水着持ってこようかな。 誰か一緒に入ってくれないかな……
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I should go grab my swimsuit. I wonder if anyone will swim with me...

Entry.JapaneseText: いい歳して 水の中でひとりはしゃぐのも みっともないわよね……
Entry.EnglishText: Once you're old enough, it starts to get embarrassing to play in the water all on your own, y'know...?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも…… 飛び込みたい……
Entry.EnglishText: But... I really wanna jump in...

Entry.JapaneseText: 水に飛び込もうとしたら 勘違いされて 引き止められちゃった
Entry.EnglishText: I tried to take a dive, but someone misunderstood and pulled me back.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「死んじゃいけない！ あなたの未来は可能性で いっぱいだ！」って
Entry.EnglishText: "You can't just go and die! Your future is full of so many possibilities!" they said.

Entry.JapaneseText: 水に飛び込もうとしたら 自殺と間違えられちゃった
Entry.EnglishText: I tried to jump into the water, but someone thought I was trying to kill myself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 失礼な話よね、 この生きる気満々の顔してる 私に対して
Entry.EnglishText: That's so rude, right? Why would you assume that about me? You can see my joie de vivre all over my face.

Entry.JapaneseText: 水に飛び込みたい……
Entry.EnglishText: I just wanna take a dive...

Entry.JapaneseText: 服のままでもいいかしら…… いや、ないわね…… それはないわ
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe it'll be okay to just take a little dip with my clothes on... No, I shouldn't... I really shouldn't.

Entry.JapaneseText: 水に入りたいけど…… きっと入ってから がっかりするんだわ……
Entry.EnglishText: I want to go in the water, but... I'm sure I'd just be disappointed if I did...

Entry.JapaneseText: 思ったよりも 水がぬるくて、 落ち込んじゃうのよ
Entry.EnglishText: The water'll probably be way warmer than I expected, and that's just depressing.

Entry.JapaneseText: この村は１年を通して暑いが 暑い時はもっと暑いんだ
Entry.EnglishText: This village is hot all year, but it's still hotter at some times than at others.

Entry.JapaneseText: どれくらい暑いかというと…… アセリア法律事典くらい
Entry.EnglishText: "How hot is it?" Hmm... Probably about as hot as Yuri Lowell.

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑い暑い…… 本当に暑い……
Entry.EnglishText: It's hot... It's hot... It's really, very hot...

Entry.JapaneseText: たまに空から水が落ちてくるの。 あれは「雨」って言うらしいね
Entry.EnglishText: Sometimes, water falls from the sky. Apparently, they call that "rain."

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしたちは
Entry.EnglishText: But we call it...

Entry.JapaneseText: 「神様の涙」って呼んでるの
Entry.EnglishText: "The Tears of God."

Entry.JapaneseText: みんな神様なんて 信じてないのに変なの
Entry.EnglishText: It's kinda weird, since no one around here really believes in gods.

Entry.JapaneseText: 雨が降ったからって 何もどうもならないんだけど
Entry.EnglishText: Nothing really happens when rain falls, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: だって本当に少しだけだし、 雨は全部砂の中。 それに、この村には水あるしね
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, there's always so little of it, it just sinks right into the sand. And this village has water already.

Entry.JapaneseText: 風は生ぬるいし……
Entry.EnglishText: And the wind's always so tepid...

Entry.JapaneseText: 生ぬるいっていうか暑いし…… ヤケドしそう
Entry.EnglishText: No, not even tepid, it's always outright hot... Almost hot enough to burn you.

Entry.JapaneseText: 暑い砂漠の風に吹かれて 私の心も熱くなってくれれば いいんだけど……
Entry.EnglishText: If only this hot desert wind could light the flames of passion in my heart...

Entry.JapaneseText: こうしてるとだんだん、 いろんなことがどうでも よくなってくんのよ
Entry.EnglishText: When things continue like this, I find myself caring a little less every day. About everything.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は実際、 「シグルド」という組織に いました
Entry.EnglishText: Truth be told, I was a member of that "Sigurd" organization, once.

Entry.JapaneseText: 少しでもその行動に意見すれば その人間は死をもって 制裁されました
Entry.EnglishText: If anyone voiced so much as the slightest disagreement about the group's actions, death would be their punishment.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「シグルド」は 恐ろしい組織です
Entry.EnglishText: "Sigurd," as an organization, is terrifying.

Entry.JapaneseText: 外でも多くの命を犠牲に していましたが、中でも また多くの人が粛清されたのです
Entry.EnglishText: They've made a great many victims of people outside their ranks, but they've purged a great many members, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「シグルド」が全員 捕まったと言います
Entry.EnglishText: They're saying all of the members of "Sigurd" have been caught.

Entry.JapaneseText: 捕まる前に 辞めてよかったです
Entry.EnglishText: I'm glad I quit before it came to this.

Entry.JapaneseText: それとも加担がバレたら、 私も捕まるのでしょうか？
Entry.EnglishText: Or maybe they'll arrest me, too, if they find out I was one of them, once.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何はともあれ、 「シグルド」が捕まって よかったです
Entry.EnglishText: It's good "Sigurd" have been caught, at any rate.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんな無法な連中が 野放しになってるなんて それこそ大変ですから
Entry.EnglishText: If a lawless group like that are left to run free, it'll be a real disaster, before long.

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドの残党狩りが 始まっているそうです
Entry.EnglishText: It seems they've started rounding up Sigurd's remnants.

Entry.JapaneseText: とっくの昔に辞めた 私にもその追求の手は 伸びてくるのでしょうか
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if the long arm of the law will come after me, even though I quit them long ago.

Entry.JapaneseText: とは言え、私は直接、何か 悪いことをしていた わけではありません
Entry.EnglishText: Though, it's not like I was directly involved in any of their criminal acts, myself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は食事のお世話をするだけの ぺーぺーでしたから……
Entry.EnglishText: I was just a grunt who helped prepare the meals...

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠を歩く時は、 バジリスクに気つけるのが この村の常識だ
Entry.EnglishText: Everyone from this village knows, if you're walking through the desert, you keep an eye out for basilisks.

Entry.JapaneseText: 会った時は 全速力逃げるか、 戦うしかない
Entry.EnglishText: And if you run into one, you run as fast as you can, or you leap right into battle.

Entry.JapaneseText: 逃げるといっても バジリスクは思いの外、 足が早いんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: And if you do choose to run, keep in mind that basilisks are a lot faster than you'd think.

Entry.JapaneseText: まず逃げきれず 石にされてしまう
Entry.EnglishText: There's a good chance they'll turn you to stone before you get away.

Entry.JapaneseText: 根絶を目的にバジリスク討伐隊が 定期的に結成されるが らちが空かない
Entry.EnglishText: Basilisk subjugation squads are formed pretty regularly, always trying to wipe them out for good, but no luck so far.

Entry.JapaneseText: やつらは数が多すぎるのだ
Entry.EnglishText: There's just too many of them.

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスク討伐隊は 大抵、途中で全滅してしまう
Entry.EnglishText: Usually, the basilisk subjugation squads get wiped out themselves at some point in their patrol.

Entry.JapaneseText: その大半が バジリスクではなく、 砂漠の暑さにやられるのだな
Entry.EnglishText: And most of them don't even get killed by the basilisks, but just the heat.

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスクは １匹見かけたら １００匹はいると思っていい
Entry.EnglishText: If you see one basilisk, you should assume there's ninety- nine more you haven't seen.

Entry.JapaneseText: 油断は大敵だ。 ほっておけば 繁殖するぞ
Entry.EnglishText: Negligence is your greatest enemy. If you leave any of them be, more'll spring up, before long.

Entry.JapaneseText: バジリスクの生態は なぞに包まれている
Entry.EnglishText: The origin of the basilisks is shrouded in mystery.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一度に１億個近い卵を 生み、そのほんの数個だけが ふ化すると言う
Entry.EnglishText: It's said they lay nearly 100,000,000,000 eggs at a time, but only a small handful of those will ever hatch.

Entry.JapaneseText: いやぁ～今日は涼しいね～。 そう思わないかい？
Entry.EnglishText: Maaan~ It's nice and cool outside today~ Don't you think so, too?

Entry.JapaneseText: 思わないのかい？ おかしいな……
Entry.EnglishText: What, you don't? That's odd...

Entry.JapaneseText: 昨日よりは２度は 温度が低いはずだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: I'm pretty sure it's about 2 degrees cooler today than it was yesterday...

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日はずいぶん 過ごしやすいよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is really nice weather.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんて今日は暑いんだ！ 昨日よりも４度は暑い！
Entry.EnglishText: Today's kind of hot! It's 4 degrees hotter than it was yesterday!

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、本当の暑さは まだまだこれからなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: But if you think this is *really* hot, you haven't seen anything yet.

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に暑い日は こんなもんじゃないよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is nothing compared to true heat.

Entry.JapaneseText: 汗すら一瞬にして 乾いてしまって あっと言う間にミイラだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Your sweat will evaporate in the blink of an eye, and before you know it, you'll be dry as a mummy.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日は肌寒いな。 君たちはそんな薄着で 大丈夫なのかい？
Entry.EnglishText: It's kind of chilly today. Are you really going to be okay, dressing that light?

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕は 後２、３枚は着込まないと 風邪ひいちゃうよ
Entry.EnglishText: I'll probably catch a cold if I don't throw on an extra two or three layers.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……強がりを言ってるわけじゃ 全然ないんだからね、 絶対！
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm not trying to act tough or anything. I swear on my uncle!

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠は一面、砂、砂、砂…… これが全部、砂糖だとして……
Entry.EnglishText: The desert's just sand, and sand, and sand... If all of this were sugar, then...

Entry.JapaneseText: こりゃすげー…… 蟻がたかりまくりだぜ
Entry.EnglishText: That'd be insane... The whole place'd be swarming with ants.

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂、砂、砂…… これが全部砂糖なら 毎日、舐め放題だ
Entry.EnglishText: Sand, sand, sand... If all of this were sugar, you could lick up as much as you like, every single day.

Entry.JapaneseText: そしたら、この村は オリーブヴィレッジじゃなく 糖尿村だ！
Entry.EnglishText: And then we wouldn't be Olive Village, we'd be Diabetes Village!

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠は一面、砂、砂、砂…… これが全部、小麦粉なら パンケーキ食い放題、焼き放題だ！
Entry.EnglishText: The desert's just sand, and sand, and sand... If this were all flour, you could cook and eat all the pancakes you like!

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎日、パンケーキ、いいだろ～♪ ……村のみんなも食い放題だから 自慢できないのか
Entry.EnglishText: Pancakes, every day! Sounds amazing~ ♪ ...But everyone in the village'd do the same, so it wouldn't be all that special.

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂、砂、砂…… これが小麦粉だったら 天ぷら食い放題だ
Entry.EnglishText: Sand, sand, sand... If all of this were flour, you could eat all the tempura you like.

Entry.JapaneseText: ドーナツも、からあげも、 パスタも食い放題だ。 サーターアンダギーもだぞ
Entry.EnglishText: Donuts, fried chicken, pasta, all as much as you like. And sata andagi, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂だ、砂だ！ この砂が砂糖だったら……
Entry.EnglishText: It's sand! It's sand! If all of this sand were sugar, then...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、この砂が 小麦粉だったら……
Entry.EnglishText: No, if all of it were flour...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ふっ…… 無駄な妄想力だな 砂は砂だよな……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hm... I'm letting my imagination run away too much. It's all just sand, at the end of the day...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……砂って食えるのかな。 食ったらもしかしたら 美味かったりして……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wonder if you can eat sand. Maybe it'd be pretty tasty if I gave it a try...

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂料理…… ……ありえねー
Entry.EnglishText: Sand-based cooking... ...Nah, no way that'd work.

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪フレ、雪フレ、 フレーフレー！
Entry.EnglishText: Fall, snow! Fall, snow! Falll! Falll!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ボク…… 雪見た時ないんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I...have never seen snow...

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪って北の方で降るんだよね。 空からいっぱい 甘いヤツが降ってくるって聞いた
Entry.EnglishText: Snow falls to the north! I heard it's all this sweet stuff that falls straight down from the sky.

Entry.JapaneseText: お腹いっぱい、 雪がたべたいなぁ～
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna eat it till I'm stuffed silly~

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪フレ、フレーー！
Entry.EnglishText: Fall, snow! Fall~!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなことしてて 雪降らないかなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: But snow probably won't start falling just 'cause I ask it to...

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪を材料にして 家が作れるんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: You can make houses out of snow, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクはそれで 家出した時専用のお家、 作るんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I'll make a house just for me out of it, for when I leave home.

Entry.JapaneseText: フレーフレー！ 雪ー！ 降らないかな、雪……！
Entry.EnglishText: Falllll! Falllll! Snooow! Are you not gonna fall, snow...!?

Entry.JapaneseText: だってさ、雪降ったら、 寒くなるんでしょ？ この村、暑すぎるもん！
Entry.EnglishText: C'mon, if snow starts falling, the village'll cool down, right? It's way too hot here, anyway!

Entry.JapaneseText: 雪が降ったら、この村も きっともっと涼しくなるよね？
Entry.EnglishText: If snow fell, this village would definitely turn way cooler than it is now, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: もう暑いのはたくさんなんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: And there's already way too much hot stuff here!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……砂と空と太陽と…… そんなものしかない村……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Sand, sky, sun, and... That's all there really is in this village...

Entry.JapaneseText: はぁ…… 引っ越したいなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Haaah... I wanna move somewhere else...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここ家賃とか 格安なんだよね……
Entry.EnglishText: But rent and all that are way cheaper here...

Entry.JapaneseText: 都会で仕事を探しても 私がつける仕事なんて たかが知れてる……
Entry.EnglishText: And even if I looked for a job in the city, there's not much I'm qualified for...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私、ずっとこの村から 出ることは できないのかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if I'll ever be able to leave this village...

Entry.JapaneseText: はぁ…… アルヴァニスタあたりに 行きたいなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Haaah... I wanna go to Alvanista, or around there...

Entry.JapaneseText: アルヴァニスタに行って 魔法道具を売って ウハウハ……
Entry.EnglishText: Go to Alvanista, and sell magical goods, and live a rose-colored life...

Entry.JapaneseText: なんて 妄想もいいとこだよね……
Entry.EnglishText: I guess fantasy's always more fun than reality, huh...?

Entry.JapaneseText: いつも部屋は砂だらけ、 気付けば口の中がじゃりじゃり 洗濯物も汚れてる……
Entry.EnglishText: There's always sand in my room, and before I know it, my mouth's all gritty, and the laundry, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私、こんな村、もうイヤ！ アルヴァニスタへ、行く！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sick of this village! I'm going to Alvanista!

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、私、こんな村でも 捨てられない！ だって……
Entry.EnglishText: But, I can't just abandon this village, however crappy it is! Because...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あれ？ なんでだっけ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Um, wait? Why was it, again?

Entry.JapaneseText: この村はもともと、砂漠を越える キャラバンたちの補給基地として 作られたそうよ
Entry.EnglishText: Originally, this village was just established as a supply depot for desert-traveling merchants.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今ではすっかり普通に人が 暮らしちゃってるけど
Entry.EnglishText: But people live completely normal lives here now.

Entry.JapaneseText: えらそうに言ってるけど、 私も最近ここへ来たの
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe I'll seem a little snobbish saying it, but I only came here recently, myself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠を越えようとしたけど、 断念しただけなんだけど
Entry.EnglishText: Well, though, my reason's just that I was trying to cross the desert and gave up.

Entry.JapaneseText: この村、砂だらけで えらく住みづらいんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: This village's lousy with sand, and that makes it a very tough place to live.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも住めば都って言葉、 あながちウソでもないのよ
Entry.EnglishText: But they say anywhere can be comfy once you've settled in, and there's some truth in that.

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂だらけの街だけど いいところはたくさんあるの
Entry.EnglishText: It may be a town lousy with sand, but there are a lot of good things about it, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 乾燥してるから 洗濯物がすぐに乾くのよ！
Entry.EnglishText: It's always parched, so your laundry will dry in a flash!

Entry.JapaneseText: 砂漠の中には 他にもいくつか オアシスがあるわ
Entry.EnglishText: There are several other oases throughout the desert, actually.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、この村の水場が 一番大きいわね
Entry.EnglishText: But this village's watering hole is the biggest of all of them.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたたちも この村に住んでみない？ きっと損はさせないわよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Why don't you try living here, too? I promise you won't regret it!

Entry.JapaneseText: はい いいえ
Entry.EnglishText: Yes No
